d:
Amit Shah addresses a gathering on Samvidhan Gaurav Diwas in New Delhi, speaking about the Constitution, its values, democracy and the contributions of its makers. He criticises the Congress party over the Emergency and targets Rahul Gandhi over his remarks on constitutional institutions. He also speaks about the Uniform Civil Code (UCC), 33% reservation for women in Parliament and State Assemblies, and the vision of a developed India by 2047.
Thank you for watching our video!
